blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Text-to-image diffusion models can generate images that satisfy complex prompts, yet often produce images that omit requested objects, attributes, or relationships. We ask if models can more reliably generate text-aligned images by redistributing probability toward their more successful outcomes. We propose TrailMix, a training-free method that uses the base model's distribution of possible outcomes to adaptively guide generation toward better text alignment. During denoising, TrailMix generates inexpensive lookahead images from parallel trajectories (trails) and scores their alignment with the prompt using an external judge. The resulting distribution of reward scores allows us to estimate how strongly to steer generation toward a desired alignment level. We use these estimates to reweight and resample trajectories, favoring more promising outcomes. Across three text-to-image benchmarks, TrailMix outperforms existing baselines, with particularly strong gains on rare multi-object compositions. We further extend TrailMix to targeted image editing and introduce SEAM-Bench (Semantic Editing and Attribute Maintenance), a systematic benchmark evaluating whether semantic edits preserve other image content. Experiments on SEAM-Bench and existing benchmark PIE-Bench demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach for controlled image editing. Our results show how a model's own possible outcomes can inform reliable and controllable generation.
blocks.zh: 文本到图像的传播模型可以生成满足复杂提示的图像,但往往生成省略所请求的对象,属性,或关系等的图像. 我们询问,模型能否通过重新分配更成功结果的概率,更可靠地生成文本相通的图像。 我们提出TrailMix,一种无培训方法,它利用基准模型对可能结果的分布来适应性地引导生成者更好地调整文本。 在解密期间,TrailMix从平行的轨迹(轨迹)中生成廉价的外观图像,并使用外部判断器将其与即时进行比对。 由此而来的奖励分数分配,使我们能够估计如何有力地引导一代人达到理想的一致水平。 我们利用这些估计来重新加重和再现出轨迹,有利于取得更有希望的结果。 从文字到图像的三项基准来看,TrailMix的绩效超过了现有的基线,在稀有的多对象组成上特别有显著的收获. 我们进一步将TrailMix扩展为定向图像编辑,并引入SEAM-Bench(语义编辑和属性维护),这是一个系统性的基准,评估语义编辑是否保存了其他图像内容. 关于SEAM-Bench和现有基准PIE-Bench的实验表明我们控制图像编辑方法的有效性. 我们的结果表明,一个模型本身的可能结果如何为可靠和可控制的一代人提供信息。

blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Method overview. For the prompt “a blue bird and a yellow canary,” we compare three strategies. Best-of- N N selects the highest-scoring final sample, while Feynman-Kac (FK) resamples particles during denoising using one-step reward predictions. TrailMix uses inexpensive lookahead previews to identify promising trajectories and adaptive steering strength to produce the most aligned images.
blocks.zh: 图1:方法概览。 我们比较了三种策略, 最佳N选取得分最高的最终取样,而Feynman-Kac(FK)则在用一步奖励预测来去诺时再取出粒子. TrailMix使用廉价的外观前置预览来识别有前途的轨迹和适应性转向力来制作最相通的图像.

blocks.en: Text-to-image diffusion models have shown impressive performance across tasks [ 35 , 33 ] , yet they can still fail to produce images that satisfy specific semantic requirements of a query [ 13 , 17 , 32 , 48 ] , such as counts or compositions of multiple objects.
blocks.zh: 文本到图像传播模型在任务之间表现出了令人印象深刻的性能[35,33],然而它们仍然可能无法生成符合查询特定语义要求的图像[13,17,32,48],例如多个对象的计数或组成.

blocks.en: Reward guidance has shown promise in improving image-text alignment via a reward function that scores how well an image satisfies its prompt. This function is often implemented using a pretrained reward model [ 45 ] or a vision-language model judge [ 36 ] . Reward-based finetuning methods optimize diffusion models toward preferred outputs [ 3 , 9 , 7 , 43 ] , but require model optimization which can degrade general capabilities [ 8 ] . Inference-time approaches instead leverage reward information without modifying the pretrained model. Best-of- N N sampling generates independent candidates and selects the highest-reward image. However, it allocates a large amount of computation to completing low-reward, misaligned candidates that are ultimately discarded [ 5 ] .
blocks.zh: 奖励指导表明,通过奖励功能改善图像文本对齐方面很有希望,这种功能对图像如何满足其迅速性进行评分。 此功能常被使用事先训练的奖励模式[45]或视觉语言模式法官[36]来实施. 基于奖励的微调方法优化了向偏好输出的传播模式[3,9,7,43],但需要模型优化,可降低一般能力[8]. 相反,推理时间办法利用奖励信息,而不修改预先训练过的模型。 最佳NN采样产生独立候选人并选择最高奖的图像. 然而,它分配了大量的计算来完成最终被抛弃的低报酬,错位相通的候选人[5].

blocks.en:
Recent methods use reward information during the generation process itself. Particle-based sampling and search methods, like Feynman-Kac (FK) steering, evaluate intermediate trajectories and allocate computation toward promising outcomes [ 26 , 38 , 50 , 14 ] . However, noisy intermediate previews may not yet reveal the semantic details needed to assess alignment with complex prompts [ 40 , 47 , 15 ] . Guidance-based methods take a complementary approach, incorporating reward-derived gradients into denoising updates [ 2 ] . For example, LiDAR [ 22 ] uses a few coarse denoising steps to generate inexpensive lookahead images , whose rewards inform an analytic correction to the denoising score.
However, we identify another benefit of lookahead images. By revealing semantic details that are difficult to assess in noisy intermediate previews, these images allow us to better estimate the alignment of potential outcomes when resampling trajectories.
blocks.zh:
最近的方法在生成过程中使用奖励信息. 基于颗粒的取样和搜索方法,如Feynman-Kac(FK)指向,评价中间轨迹,并分配计算以取得有希望的结果[26、38、50、14]。 然而,喧闹的中间预览可能尚未揭示评估与复杂提示相匹配所需的语义细节[40,47,15]. 以指导为基础的方法采取补充办法,将奖励产生的梯度纳入去名更新[2]。 例如,LiDAR [22] 使用一些粗糙的去诺步骤生成廉价的外观头像,其奖励为解诺分数的分析修正提供了依据.
然而,我们发现,外观图像的另一个好处。 通过揭示出在吵闹的中间预览中难以评估的语义细节,这些图像使我们能够在再现轨迹时更好地估计潜在结果的相接性.

blocks.en:
We therefore propose TrailMix , a training-free method that adaptively combines the pretrained model’s generative distribution with reward-based selection to improve image-text alignment (Figure 1 ). Building on FK steering [ 38 ] , we run multiple denoising trajectories ( trails ) in parallel and periodically resample them using rewards computed from lookahead images. Beyond improving expected reward estimation, we adapt how strongly resampling favors higher-reward trails.
The model’s own possible generations thus inform both trajectory selection and how strongly rewards influence sampling.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们提议采用无培训方法TrailMix, 将预先训练过的模型的基因分布与奖励性选择相适应, 在FK方向盘[38]的基础上,我们并行运行多条去诺分轨迹(出轨迹),并使用从外观图像计算出的奖励来定期地再现. 除了改进预期的奖励估计之外,我们调整了如何大力地重新树立优胜劣负。
因此,模型本身的几代人既为轨迹选择提供了依据,也为如何大力奖励取样提供了依据。

blocks.en: We evaluate TrailMix on GenEval [ 13 ] , T2I-CompBench++ [ 17 ] , and RareBench [ 32 ] , using Stable Diffusion v1.4 (SDv1.4) and Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL). TrailMix consistently improves prompt alignment over four-particle baselines across both models, with the largest gains on rare multi-object compositions, where it outperforms Best-of-8 using half as many particles.
blocks.zh: 我们在GenEval [13], T2I-Comp Bench++ [17] 和 Rare Bench [32] 上评价有轨电车,使用稳定分化v1.4(SDv1.4)和稳定分化XL(SDXL). TrailMix在两种模型的四颗粒子基线上不断改进了即时对接,在稀有多对象成分上收益最大,在其中利用了一半的粒子,其性能超过了"最佳-8".

blocks.en: The same steering mechanism also extends to targeted image editing. We introduce SEAM-Bench (Semantic Editing and Attribute Maintenance Benchmark), a systematic, attribute-level benchmark that jointly evaluates edit success and preservation of unrelated image details, including edits toward and against stereotypical associations. TrailMix achieves the highest edit success among evaluated methods on SEAM-Bench across both diffusion models, while maintaining strong source preservation. Its benefits also extend to existing images on PIE-Bench [ 20 ] , particularly with SDXL, and to counter-stereotypical editing, where it achieves more balanced success across editing directions.
blocks.zh: 同样的指导机制也延伸到目标图像编辑. 我们采用了SEAM-Bench(语义编辑和属性维护基准),这是一个系统化、属性层面的基准,它共同评价编辑成功和保存不相关的图像细节,包括针对和反对定型协会的编辑。 TrailMix在SEAM-Bench上通过两种传播模式的评价方法中取得了最高的编辑成功,同时保持了强源保存. 其好处还扩展到PIE-Bench [20]上的现有图像,特别是SDXL,以及反定型编辑,在编辑方向上取得更平衡的成功.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Finetuning-based alignment. Finetuning approaches update diffusion model parameters to improve alignment with reward objectives. DDPO and DPOK [ 3 , 9 ] optimize rewards through reinforcement learning, DRaFT [ 7 ] backpropagates reward gradients through sampling, and Diffusion-DPO [ 43 ] learns from preference pairs. However, over-optimizing rewards can increase scores at the expense of image quality and diversity [ 24 , 19 ] . We focus on inference-time steering, which adapts generation without further model training. These approaches broadly include guidance-based methods and sampling methods.
blocks.zh: 以微调为主的对接. 细化方法更新推广模式参数,以更好地与奖励目标相配合. DDPO和DPOK[3,9]通过强化学习来优化奖励,DRAFT[7]通过采样来回传播奖励梯度,而分化-DPO[43]从偏好对学习. 然而,过度优化的奖励可以以牺牲图像质量和多样性而提高分数[24,19]. 我们侧重于推论时间指导,这种指导在不进行进一步模式培训的情况下对一代进行调整。 这些方法广泛包括以指导为基础的方法和取样方法。

blocks.en: Guidance-based methods. SEGA [ 4 ] steers generation along text-defined semantic directions, while Prompt-to-Prompt [ 16 ] controls cross-attention maps to edit image content while preserving its layout. Universal Guidance [ 2 ] and FreeDoM [ 46 ] adjust denoising updates using gradients of differentiable objectives. LiDAR [ 22 ] uses inexpensive lookahead images and their rewards to compute an analytic guidance correction.
blocks.zh: 指导性方法. SEGA [4] 沿文本定义的语义方向来引导生成,而即时到Prompt [16] 控制跨意向映射来编辑图像内容,同时保留其布局. Universal Guide [2]和FreeDoM [46] 使用不同目标的梯度来调整去诺更新. LiDAR [22] 使用廉价的外观头像及其奖励来计算出一个分析指导校正.

blocks.en: Sampling and search methods. Sampling and search methods allocate computation across candidate trajectories. Best-of- N N selects among completed images, while noise search refines noise inputs, PSP prunes candidates, and DTS reuses completed rollouts to guide tree exploration [ 28 , 14 , 18 ] . TDS and DAS apply sequential Monte Carlo to conditional generation and reward alignment, respectively [ 44 , 21 ] , while SVDD selects transitions using estimated future rewards [ 26 ] . Feynman-Kac (FK) steering [ 38 ] maintains parallel denoising trajectories and resamples them at intermediate steps using reward-based weights. Building on this framework, TrailMix evaluates trajectories through short lookahead continuations and uses the resulting reward distribution to adapt resampling.
blocks.zh: 采样与搜寻方法. 抽样和搜索方法在候选轨迹中分配计算。 在完成的图像中选择最佳NN,而噪声搜索则精细地改进了噪声输入,PSP普鲁士候选人,DTS再利用完成推开来指导树木探索[28,14,18]. TDS和DAS分别将相继的蒙特卡洛用于有条件的生成和奖赏比对[44,21],而SVDD则使用估计的未来奖赏[26]来选择过渡. Feynman-Kac (FK) Direction [38] 保持平行去诺的轨迹并用以奖赏为分量的分量在中间步骤上再作复制. 基于这个框架,TrailMix通过短视前的续作来评价轨迹,并使用由此得到的奖励分配来调整再生.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: TrailMix steers a pretrained diffusion model toward images that better satisfy the semantic requirements of a text prompt. It runs multiple denoising trajectories in parallel and uses inexpensive lookahead previews to assess their possible outcomes before generation is complete (see Figure 1 ). A reward judge scores these previews for alignment with the prompt, and the resulting scores determine both how strongly to steer and which trajectories to favor (see Algorithm 1 ). We first define the reward-guided target distribution ( Sec. 3.1 ) and introduce lookahead previews ( Sec. 3.2 ), then describe adaptive steering strength ( Sec. 3.3 ) and its implementation through reward estimation and resampling ( Sec. 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: TrailMix引导一种预受训练的传播模型向图像方向走去,这些图像更好地满足了文本提示的语义要求. 它平行运行多个去诺化轨道并使用廉价的外观前预览,在生成完成之前评估其可能的结果(见图一)。 奖励法官对这些预览进行评分,使其与快取对等,结果的分数既决定了引导的强度,也决定了哪一个轨道偏好(参见算法 1 . 我们首先界定了奖励指导目标分布(第3.1节)并引入了外观前导预览(第3.2节),然后描述适应性引导强度(第3.3节),并通过奖励估计和再作说明加以实施(第3.4节)。

blocks.en: (ii) Selection during denoising. These methods evaluate unfinished trajectories to decide where to allocate further computation. FK steering [ 38 ] periodically resamples trajectories using judge-derived weights, duplicating promising trajectories and discarding others. Resampling preserves the population size, although duplicated trajectories share an intermediate state and may produce similar images. We also compare with PSP [ 14 ] , BFS [ 50 ] , SVDD-PM [ 26 ] , and DTS [ 18 ] , which use alternative pruning, transition-selection, and search strategies.
blocks.zh: (二) 授意期间的选择。 这些方法评价未完成的轨迹,以决定分配进一步计算的地点. FK向导 [38] 利用判官产生的权重,定期重现出轨迹,复制有希望的轨迹并抛弃其他轨迹. 复出保存了人口规模,虽然重复的轨迹共享了中间状态并可能产生相类似的图像. 我们还与PSP[14]、BFS[50]、SVDD-PM[26]和DTS[18]进行了比较,它们采用了替代性的打压、过渡选择和搜索策略。

blocks.en: (iii) Guidance and attention control. These methods modify generation within individual trajectories. LiDAR [ 22 ] , Universal Guidance [ 2 ] , and FreeDoM [ 46 ] apply reward-derived corrections, while SEGA [ 4 ] and Prompt-to-Prompt [ 16 ] control semantic directions and attention, respectively.

blocks.en: Benchmarks and evaluation. We assess how well generated images satisfy their prompts on three benchmarks with independent evaluators, separate from the reward judges used during generation. Scores are reported on a 0 0 - 100 100 scale, with higher values indicating better alignment. RareBench [ 32 ] tests whether models can generate unusual objects and combinations of objects using 320 320 prompts. GPT-4o [ 31 ] rates how well each image matches its prompt on a 1 1 - 5 5 scale, which we rescale to 0 0 - 100 100 . We report single-object and multi-object results separately. GenEval [ 13 ] evaluates 553 553 prompts across six categories. According to the standard GenEval protocol, we use Mask2Former [ 6 ] to check object presence, counts, and spatial relationships, and CLIP ViT-L/14 [ 34 ] to check object colors and color attribution. We report the average success rate across all categories (Overall), along with Counting, Position, and Color attribution scores. T2I-CompBench++ [ 17 ] tests compositional alignment using 1,500 1{,}500 prompts across five categories. Binding measures whether colors, shapes, and textures are assigned to the correct objects, averaging BLIP-VQA scores [ 25 ] across these three attributes. UniDet [ 51 ] evaluates Spatial and Numeracy categories, verifying relationships between objects and object counts, respectively.
blocks.zh: 基准和评价。 我们评估生成良好的图像如何满足他们与独立评估员的三项基准的提示,这与一代人使用的奖励法官不同。 分数按0-100分比例报告,较高值表明比对更好。 Rare Bench [32] 测试模型是否可以使用320 320个导电符生成异常对象和组合对象. GPT-4o [31] 评分每张相片与1 1 - 5 5 个相片的速率相匹配程度, 我们调整到 0 - 100 100 个相片 。 我们分别报告单对象和多对象结果。 GenEval [13] 评出553 553个提示分为6个类别. 根据GenEval标准协议,我们使用Mask2Former [6]来检查对象的存在,计数,和空间关系,以及CLIP VIT-L/14 [34]来检查对象的颜色和颜色归属. 我们报告所有类别(总体)的平均成功率,以及计数、位置和颜色归属分数。 T2I-Comp Bench++ [17] 使用 1,500 1{,} 500 个提示,跨越了五类. 强制测量是否将颜色、形状和纹理分配给正确的对象,平均BLIP-VQA得分[25]。 UniDet [51] 分别评价了空间和数值类别,分别验证了物体和物体计数之间的关系.

blocks.en: Inference cost. We strive for improved alignment while maintaining computational efficiency. We measure inference cost with two quantities: U-Net evaluations for denoising and judge calls for evaluating image alignment. Each denoiser prediction counts as one U-Net evaluation, so a 100 100 -step sample with classifier-free guidance requires 200 200 evaluations. Judge calls count the number of candidate images scored by the reward model, including intermediate evaluations and lookahead previews. Both measures account for the additional computation required to generate and evaluate lookaheads. For Universal Guidance and FreeDoM, judge calls instead correspond to CLIP energy evaluations. We report these costs separately because their relative importance depends on the setting: denoising may dominate generation time, while scoring with a large reward model may make judging the bottleneck.
blocks.zh: 推论成本. 我们力求在保持计算效率的同时,提高一致性。 我们用两种数量来衡量推论成本:对U-Net进行点名评价,对评价图像一致性作出判断。 每个Denoiser预测都算作一个U-Net评价,因此100个100个步骤的样本和无分类指导需要200个评价. 法官调用计数奖赏模式得分的候选人图像数量,包括中间评价与取景前预览. 这两项措施都考虑到产生和评价望头星所需的额外计算。 对于通用指南和FreeDoM, 法官的呼叫与CLIP能量评价相对应. 我们分别报告这些成本,因为它们的相对重要性取决于背景:发号施令可能支配一代人的时间,而用一个大奖赏模式评分则可能使判断瓶颈成为可能。

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Results

TrailMix improves alignment across semantic requirements, particularly for rare compositions. TrailMix outperforms FK steering and LiDAR on every reported metric and matches or exceeds Best-of-4 across both diffusion models ( Tab. 1 ). It also achieves higher overall GenEval scores than other trajectory selection and search methods, including PSP, BFS, SVDD-PM, and DTS. These improvements span object counting, spatial relationships, and attribute binding, with particularly strong results on RareBench . TrailMix achieves the highest multi-object score among the evaluated methods on both models, surpassing even Best-of-8. Its gains over FK steering and LiDAR are also larger for multi-object compositions than for single objects. This suggests that combining lookahead evaluation with adaptive resampling is especially valuable when several uncommon concepts must appear together in one image (see examples in Fig. 2 ).
blocks.zh: TrailMix改进了语义要求之间的对接,特别是对稀有成分而言. TrailMix在每一个报告的度量和比对上都优于FK向导和LiDAR,或者在两种传播模式上都超过了最佳4(表1)。 它还比其他轨迹选择和搜索方法,包括PSP,BFS,SVDD-PM,以及DTS等,实现了更高的GenEval总体分数. 这些改进跨越了物体计数、空间关系和属性约束,在Rare Bench上产生特别强烈的结果。 TrailMix在两种模型上都实现了被评价方法中最高的多对象分数,甚至超过了Best-of-8. 它在FK向导和LiDAR上的增益对于多对象成分来说也大于单个对象. 这表明,当几个不同寻常的概念必须放在一个图像中出现时(见图2中的例子),将外观评价与适应性再取样结合起来特别有价值。

blocks.en: TrailMix achieves strong alignment with fewer denoiser evaluations. TrailMix matches or exceeds Best-of-8 on key alignment metrics with 42 % 42\% fewer U-Net evaluations, though it requires additional judge calls. Compared with FK steering, lookahead previews increase denoising work but halve judge calls, while TrailMix achieves better alignment than LiDAR with lower costs on both measures. These comparisons suggest that how computation is allocated during generation matters, motivating a closer examination of performance as the particle budget increases.

blocks.en: TrailMix maintains its advantage as the particle budget grows. Increasing the number of particles generally improves generation quality, raising the question of whether the baselines can close the gap with larger populations. We evaluate this on GenEval by varying the particle budget for TrailMix , FK steering, and Best-of- N N ( Fig. 3 ). Although all three methods benefit from additional particles, TrailMix achieves higher GenEval scores at every tested population size from 4 4 to 64 64 . With only 16 16 particles, it reaches approximately the same score as the baselines with 64 64 , and its advantage continues to grow at larger budgets. The only exception is n = 2 n=2 , where it underperforms both baselines. These results show that TrailMix not only improves generation at a fixed particle budget, but also makes more effective use of larger populations.

Best-of- N N uses these scores to select a completed edit. TrailMix and the resampling and search baselines use them to select trajectories during denoising, while LiDAR uses lookahead scores to guide individual trajectories. Universal Guidance and FreeDoM use CLIP-based energies; SEGA and Prompt-to-Prompt do not use an external reward judge.

blocks.en: Benchmarks and evaluation. Existing image-editing benchmarks such as PIE-Bench evaluate edit success and source preservation using text-image alignment and visual similarity metrics [ 20 ] . We introduce SEAM-Bench (Semantic Editing and Attribute Maintenance Benchmark) to explicitly assess whether changing a requested attribute preserves other attributes in the image. The benchmark contains 316 316 controlled source-target description pairs differing in a single attribute, spanning 12 12 edit types including color, action, and material. For each pair, we generate questions to evaluate both the requested change and preservation of unrelated attributes. Because diffusion models can learn stereotypical associations [ 27 , 10 ] , we also include a separate cohort of 192 192 edits toward and away from these associations to assess counter-stereotypical editing and directional asymmetry. Source images are generated using the evaluated diffusion model, allowing us to reuse their initial noise during editing. Further details are provided in App. C .
blocks.zh: 基准和评价。 PIE-Bench等现有图像编辑基准使用文本图像校正和视觉相似度量度评价编辑成功和源保存[20]. 我们采用SEAM-Bench(语义编辑和属性维护基准)来明确评估更改所请求的属性是否保留了图像中的其他属性. 基准包含316,316个控制源-目标描述对,在一个单一属性中有所不同,包括了12个编辑类型,包括颜色、动作和材料。 对于每一对,我们都会产生问题来评价要求的改变和保留无关的属性。 因为传播模式可以学习陈规定型的关联[27,10],我们还包括另外一组192个针对这些关联和远离这些关联的编辑,以评估反定型编辑和方向不对称。 原始图像是使用评估的传播模型生成的,使我们能够在编辑时重新使用最初的噪音。 详情见App.C.。

blocks.en: We additionally evaluate on PIE-Bench [ 20 ] , which provides 700 700 existing source images with editing instructions and masks. Because their initial noise is unknown, we use SDEdit [ 29 ] to initialize editing from a noised version of each source. We use a strength of s = 0.3 s=0.3 , selected using the base model and fixed across both backbones.
blocks.zh: 我们还在PIE-Bench [20] 上评价,它提供了700个现有的有编辑指令和口罩的原始图像. 因为他们最初的噪声未知,我们使用SDedit[29]从每个源的噪声版本初始化编辑. 我们使用S = 0.3 s = 0.3的强度,使用基建模型选择,并固定在两个骨干上.

blocks.en: For both benchmarks, we use Gemma-3-27B [ 11 ] to evaluate edit success independently of the steering judge. We first check that each source image contains the intended subject and original attribute, but not the target attribute, ensuring that the requested edit requires an actual change. An edit succeeds when the output retains the subject, removes the original attribute, and introduces the target attribute. EditRate is the percentage of these source images successfully edited, while Context lost measures how often the subject disappears.
blocks.zh: 对于这两个基准,我们使用Gemma-3-27B[11]来评价编辑成功与否独立于指导法官. 我们首先检查每个源图像包含预定的主题和原始属性,而不是目标属性,确保请求的编辑需要实际改变. 当输出保留了主体,去掉了原属性,并引入了目标属性时,编辑成功. EditRate是这些源图像成功编辑的百分比,而Context则丢失了对主题消失频率的衡量.

blocks.en: We measure preservation separately from edit success. On SEAM-Bench , Gemma evaluates attributes that should remain unchanged. Preservation error E E is the average absolute change in its confidence that these attributes are present between the source and edited images. We also report E verified E_{\mathrm{verified}} , which measures the same error on edits where the attribute was successfully edited. Lower values indicate better preservation. On PIE-Bench, the supplied masks identify the regions intended to change. We measure target-prompt alignment within these regions using CLIP edit \mathrm{CLIP}_{\mathrm{edit}} and preservation outside them using PSNR and LPIPS. PSNR compares pixel values, while LPIPS measures perceptual differences using neural network features. Higher PSNR and lower LPIPS indicate better preservation. Structure measures changes across the whole image using DINO features; lower values are better.

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Results

TrailMix improves edit success while preserving source content. On SEAM-Bench , TrailMix achieves the highest EditRate on both backbones while maintaining low preservation error ( Fig. 4 ). On SDv1.4, it exceeds LiDAR in edit success (92.5% versus 90.5%) while reducing overall preservation error and subject loss. On SDXL, it attains 97.8% EditRate with the lowest overall preservation error and no observed subject loss, although the base model has lower preservation error when considering only successful edits ( Tab. 2 ). These results show that higher edit success can be achieved without substantially altering unrelated source content.
blocks.zh: TrailMix在保存源内容的同时改进了编辑成功. 在SEAM-Bench上,TrailMix实现了两个骨干上最高的EditRate,同时保持了低保存出错(图4). 在SDv1.4上,它在编辑成功时超过了LiDAR(92.5%对90.5%),同时减少了总体保存错误和主题损失. 在SDXL上,它取得了97.8%的编辑率,总体保存出错最少,没有观察到主题丢失,不过在考虑仅成功编辑时,基准模型的保存出错较低(Tab. 2 ). 这些结果显示,在不大幅度改变不相干源内容的情况下,可以实现更高的编辑成功.

blocks.en: TrailMix balances edit alignment and preservation on existing images. On PIE-Bench, TrailMix achieves the highest edited-region text alignment and lowest LPIPS on SDXL, along with the highest EditRate among particle-based selection baselines ( Tab. 2 ). LiDAR achieves higher edit success (15.6% versus 13.6%) but introduces larger structural and perceptual changes. On SDv1.4, TrailMix improves EditRate over the base model and Best-of-4 and retains strong source preservation, although several baselines achieve higher edit success. Thus, the SDXL results offer the clearest evidence of improved edit alignment with limited changes to the source.

blocks.en: We examine the two main components of TrailMix : lookahead-based reward estimation and adaptive steering strength. We vary the lookahead length and compare adaptive and fixed steering strengths on SDv1.4 with four particles, holding all other settings fixed ( Tab. 4 ). We perform additional ablations to investigate the impact of reward threshold, preview budget, particle count, resampling schedule, and reward judges (App. D ).
blocks.zh: 我们研究了TrailMix的两个主要组成部分:基于外观的奖励估计和适应性引导力。 我们将SDv1.4上的可适应性和固定转向力与四颗粒子进行比较,将所有其他设置固定(Tab. 4 ) 。 我们进行额外的活化来调查奖励阈值的影响、预览预算、粒子计数、再取样时间表以及奖励法官(App. D ) 。

blocks.en: Short lookaheads improve alignment relative to one-step predictions. Four- and eight-step previews outperform one-step predictions on both GenEval and RareBench , with the largest gains on RareBench . Extending previews to sixteen steps increases computation without improving performance over eight steps. As further analyzed in App. D.1 , lookahead previews are particularly useful early in denoising, as they can more reliably identify trajectories likely to produce successful images than one-step predictions.
blocks.zh: 相较于单步预测,短视头改进了对齐. 四步和八步预览在GenEval和Rare Bench上都超过了一步预想,在Rare Bench上收获最大. 将预览扩展至16个步骤会增加计算,而不改进8个步骤的性能. 如App.D.1所进一步分析,取景前预览在解析早期特别有用,因为它们可以比一步预想更可靠地识别出可能产生成功图像的轨迹.

blocks.en: Adaptive steering adjusts selection pressure across prompts. Different fixed steering strengths perform best on GenEval and RareBench , while adaptive steering matches the best tested setting on both without benchmark-specific tuning. Further analysis shows that adaptive steering generally applies weaker selection when the base model already produces high-reward images, retaining more distinct initial trajectories than fixed steering while maintaining competitive alignment (App. D.2 ).

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduce TrailMix , a training-free approach to diffusion steering that uses the pretrained model’s possible outcomes to improve text-image alignment. By evaluating inexpensive lookahead previews, TrailMix identifies promising trajectories and adapts how strongly to favor them during resampling. Across two diffusion models, this approach improves compositional generation, with particularly strong gains on rare multi-object scenes. We further demonstrate its applicability to targeted image editing and introduce SEAM-Bench , a systematic benchmark for evaluating semantic edit success and source preservation, including edits against stereotypical associations. Together, our results show how adaptive reward estimation and resampling can better leverage the pretrained generative distribution without additional training.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了TrailMix,一种无培训的传播引导方法,它利用预先训练过的模型的可能结果来改进文本图像的校正。 TrailMix通过评价廉价的外观前期预览,确定了有希望的轨迹,并适应了在再生过程中如何强烈的偏好. 这种方法通过两种传播模式,可以改善成份生成,在稀有多物体场景上特别有显著收益. 我们进一步证明它适用于有针对性的图像编辑,并采用SEAM-Bench,这是评价语义编辑成功和源头保存的系统基准,包括针对定型协会的编辑。 我们的结果表明,适应性奖励的估算和再抽样可以更好地利用事先受过训练的基因分配,而无需经过更多的培训。

blocks.en: We describe the shared sampling settings and baseline configurations, followed by the evaluation protocols for text-to-image generation and PIE-Bench. We describe SEAM-Bench separately in Appendix C . Code to reproduce our results is provided at this repository.
blocks.zh: 我们描述了共享的取样设置和基线配置,然后是文本到图像生成和PIE-Bench的评价协议。 我们在附录C中分别描述了SEAM-Bench。 复制我们结果的代码由这个寄存器提供。

blocks.en: B.1 Models and sampling
blocks.zh: B.1 模型和取样

blocks.en: Diffusion models. We use Stable Diffusion v1.4 [ 35 ] at 512 × 512 512\times 512 resolution and SDXL base 1.0 [ 33 ] at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 . Their classifier-free guidance scales are 7.5 7.5 and 5.0 5.0 , respectively. Both models run in half precision with stochastic DDIM sampling [ 39 ] ( η = 1 \eta=1 ). Text-to-image generation and generated-source editing use 100 100 denoising steps. PIE-Bench editing uses the last 30 30 steps of this schedule, initialized with SDEdit [ 29 ] ( Sec. B.3 ).
blocks.zh: 传播模式. 我们在512×512 512\times 512分辨率下使用SDXL Base 1.0 [33] 在1024×1024 1024\times上使用稳定分化 v1.4 [35] 1024 (英语). 它们的无分级制导尺度分别为7.5 7.5和5.0 5.0. 这两个模型都以有分量的 DDIM 采样[39] (= 1\eta=1)半精度运行. Text-to-image 生成和生成源编辑使用100个去诺化步骤. PIE-Bench编辑采用本时间表后30个步骤,由SDEdit [29] (Sec. B.3.

blocks.en: Seeds and shared initialization. For each generation benchmark, we number prompts in dataset order and use the prompt index as the random seed. We draw eight initial noise samples from this seed and share them across methods: Single uses the first, four-particle methods use the first four, and Best-of-8 uses all eight. Methods with different search or pruning procedures use the same initial samples where applicable. We also seed denoising, preview generation, and resampling for reproducibility, but do not synchronize the noise drawn during later denoising steps across methods. Source-image initialization for editing is described in Secs. B.3 and C.2 .
blocks.zh: 种子与共享初始化. 对于每代基准,我们按数据集顺序编号提示并使用提示索引作为随机种子. 我们从这些种子中抽取了八个初步的噪音样本,并用各种方法分享这些样本: 单用第一,四颗粒子方法用前四,而Best-8则全部用上八. 采用不同搜索或运行程序的方法酌情使用相同的初始样本。 我们还为可复制性进行播种、预览生成和再生,但不要将以后不同方法的去诺步骤所产生的噪音同步。 用于编辑的源图像初始化在Secs.B.3和C.2.中被描述.

blocks.en: TrailMix previews and resampling. For generation, TrailMix maintains four denoising trajectories and resamples after steps 10 10 and 80 80 . At each checkpoint, it copies each particle’s current state and generates one clean-image preview using L = 8 L=8 coarse DDIM steps on evenly spaced timesteps. The reward judge scores these previews, which are then discarded; the original particle states are left unchanged. Preview noise uses a separate random stream from the continuing trajectories.
blocks.zh: TrailMix预览和再生. 对于一代人来说,TrailMix在步骤10和80 80之后维持了四个去诺化的轨迹和再生. 在每一个检查点,它都会复制出每个粒子的当前状态,并用L=8 L=8粗度 DDIM步骤在均匀的间隔时间步上生成一个清真图像预览. 奖励法官对这些预览进行分数,然后丢弃;原始粒子状态保持不变. 预览噪声使用从持续轨迹中分离出的一个随机流.

blocks.en: We then use systematic resampling with the probabilities defined below to select four particles with replacement. Each selected particle resumes from its original checkpoint state, and duplicated particles receive independent denoising noise. We complete all four trajectories after the last checkpoint and return the highest-reward final image.

blocks.en: Baseline configurations. All reward-based sampling baselines use ImageReward for generation and the editing reward defined in Sec. B.3 for editing. Their denoising trajectories use the shared DDIM sampler and initial noises where applicable; LiDAR also uses DPM-Solver for its lookahead samples. We follow the schedules in the original papers or released implementations and use a nominal four-trajectory budget for the sampling and search baselines. Each method allocates this budget according to its selection strategy. We report the actual U-Net and judge-call costs in the result tables.
blocks.zh: 基线配置。 所有基于奖励的采样基线都使用Image Reward for generation和Sec.B.3中定义的编辑奖励进行编辑. 它们的去诺能轨迹使用共享的DDIM采样器和相宜的初始噪声;LiDAR还使用DPM-Solver来取其外观头部样品. 我们遵循原始文件中的时间表或公布的执行情况,并使用名义上的四轨预算进行取样和搜索基线。 每种方法都根据其选择战略分配预算。 我们在结果表中报告实际的U-Net和法官召唤费用。

blocks.en: Single and Best-of- N N . Single completes one trajectory without reward-based selection. We count one final reward evaluation per output for Single, consistent with the main-paper cost convention. Best-of- N N completes N N independent trajectories and returns the image with the highest reward. We evaluate Best-of-4 and Best-of-8.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2013-10-12). Single and Best-Of N N N. 单曲完成一出轨迹,不以奖励为基础进行选择. 根据主要文件费用惯例,我们计算每项产出的最后奖励评价。 Best-of-N N完成N N独立轨迹并以最高的奖励回回图像. 我们评价最佳4和最佳8。

blocks.en:
FK steering [ 38 ] .
We use the max-potential variant, which tracks the highest reward assigned to a particle’s one-step clean-image predictions. Four particles are resampled with steering strength λ = 10 \lambda=10 at sampling indices 20 20 , 40 40 , 60 60 , and 80 80 (zero-indexed), followed by a terminal scoring checkpoint. These five checkpoints require 20 20 judge calls; an additional four calls select the highest-reward completed image. The corresponding inference costs are reported in the main results.
blocks.zh:
FK方向盘 [38].
我们使用最大潜力的变体,它追踪粒子单步清洁图像预测的最高回报。 4个颗粒被以转向力XQ=10\lambda=10进行再取样,采样指数为20 20,40 40,60,和80 (零指数),然后是终端计分检查站. 这5个检查站需要20个法官电话;另外4个电话选取最高报酬的完成图像。 主要结果中报告了相应的推论费用。

blocks.en:
BFS [ 50 ] .
We follow the authors’ GenEval configuration, which uses the same four particles, max-potential rule, strength, and checkpoints as FK steering. BFS differs in two ways: it uses Srinivasan resampling instead of multinomial resampling, and it multiplies the reward at sampling index j j by 2 ​ j / T 2j/T before computing the potential. We follow this linear schedule from the released code, rather than the exponential schedule described in the paper. BFS has the same inference costs as FK steering.
blocks.zh:
BFS [50] (英语).
我们遵循作者的 GenEval 配置, BFS在两个方面有所不同:它使用斯里尼瓦桑复标而不是多名复标,在计算潜力前将采样指数jj的奖励乘以2j / T 2j/T. 我们遵循这个线性时间表,而不是报纸上描述的指数时间表。 BFS的推论费用与FK方向盘相同.

blocks.en:
PSP [ 14 ] .
Following the paper’s default schedule, PSP begins with eight candidates and prunes them as denoising proceeds. After step 25 25 , it ranks their one-step clean-image predictions and keeps four candidates; after step 50 50 , it scores the remaining candidates again and keeps two. It completes both and returns the higher-reward image. The total denoising budget matches Best-of-4 despite the larger initial population.
blocks.zh:
PSP [14] (英语).
根据该报的默认时间表,PSP从8名候选人开始,并将他们作为去名收益进行打压. 在第25步25后,它将他们的一步清洁图像预测排出排名,并保留了四名候选人;第50步50后,它再次给剩下的候选人打分,并保留两名候选人. 既能完成,又能还回高分相. 尽管初始人口较多,但全部取消提名的预算与最佳-4预算相当。

blocks.en:
SVDD-PM [ 26 ] .
We follow the authors’ implementation with α = 0 \alpha=0 . At each denoising step except the last, SVDD-PM proposes four next states, scores a one-step clean-image prediction from each, and continues from the highest-reward proposal. It draws one next state at the last step. Unlike four-particle resampling, this procedure maintains one selected path while spending a four-proposal budget at each transition. Its inference costs are reported in the main results.
blocks.zh:
SVDD-PM [26] (英语).
我们以 α = 0\ alpha = 0. 在除最后的去名步骤外的每个去名步骤,SVDD-PM都提出下四个状态,从每个状态中得分一个一步的清洁图像预测,从最高的奖励建议继续. 它在最后一步画出下一个状态. 与四颗粒再取样不同,这一程序在每次过渡期间都维持一个选定的路径,同时花费四个拟议预算预算。 主要结果中报告了其推论成本。

blocks.en:
DTS [ 18 ] .
We use DTS ⋆ , the greedy variant used for the paper’s text-to-image results. It explores a tree of denoising states, either starting from the next initial noise or extending an existing branch. At each node, it selects the child that maximizes its value plus c ​ ln ⁡ N parent / N child c\sqrt{\ln N_{\mathrm{parent}}/N_{\mathrm{child}}} , with c = 0.1 c=0.1 . It then branches by one DDIM step and completes the trajectory. Each finished image is scored once and assigned value e r e^{r} ; internal node values average those of their children. Branching is permitted after 20 20 , 40 40 , 60 60 , and 80 % 80\% of the steps, with at most ⌊ 2 ​ N 0.4 ⌋ \lfloor 2N^{0.4}\rfloor children per node of visit count N N . Search has an 800 800 -U-Net-evaluation budget, but the last rollout is completed as in the released code, yielding 916 916 evaluations and 5 5 judge calls. We return the highest-reward completed image.

blocks.en: Source initialization. PIE-Bench [ 20 ] provides 700 700 source images, each with an editing instruction and a mask marking the region to change. We resize each source to the diffusion model’s resolution and use SDEdit [ 29 ] to noise the image before denoising under the target prompt. blocks.en: We number source-image/edit pairs in dataset order and use each pair’s index as its random seed. All methods start from the same noised source image for a given pair, including Best-of- N N and the pruning, search, and guidance baselines. Candidates share this source-conditioned state but receive independent noise during subsequent denoising steps.
blocks.zh: 我们按数据集顺序对源图像/编辑成对进行编号,并使用每对索引作为其随机种子。 所有方法都从给定一对的同名源图像入手,包括Best-of-N N和穿透、搜索和引导基线。 候选人分享这种来源条件状态,但在随后的去名步骤中会收到独立的噪声.

blocks.en: Editing reward and steering. We use Qwen2.5-VL-7B [ 1 ] to ask whether a candidate contains the target attribute and whether it still contains the original attribute. For each question, we convert the probability of “yes” to log-odds, clipped to [ − 10 , 10 ] [-10,10] . The reward is the target-attribute log-odds minus the original-attribute log-odds, favoring the requested change. For addition-only or deletion-only edits, we use twice the available target log-odds or minus twice the original log-odds, respectively, to retain a comparable reward scale.
blocks.zh: 编辑奖励和引导。 我们使用Quen2.5-VL-7B [1] 来询问一个候选人是否包含目标属性,以及它是否仍然包含原始属性. 对于每个问题,我们把“是”的概率转换为对数,剪接为[-10、-10][-10、-10]。 奖励是目标属性的对数减去原属性的对数,有利于要求的更改. 对于只添加或只删除的编辑,我们分别使用可使用的目标对数的两倍或倒数的两倍来保留可比的奖励尺度.

C.2 ). The other baselines use the shortened schedules detailed in Sec. B.1 .

blocks.en: Edit success. We evaluate edits with Gemma 3 27B [ 11 ] , independently of the Qwen judge used for steering and final selection. We treat an answer as “yes” when its probability is at least 0.5 0.5 . A source is valid if it contains the subject and any attribute to be removed, but does not already contain an attribute to be added. On valid sources, an edit succeeds if the output retains the subject and makes the requested addition, deletion, or replacement.

blocks.en: SEAM-Bench (Semantic Editing and Attribute Maintenance Benchmark) evaluates whether a requested attribute change succeeds while unrelated image details are preserved. Here, we describe the benchmark construction, source-conditioned editing setup, and evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: SEAM-Bench(语义编辑和属性维护基准)评价请求的属性变化是否成功而无关的图像细节是否被保存. 在这里,我们描述基准构建,源条件编辑设置,以及评价协议.

blocks.en: C.1 Dataset construction
blocks.zh: C.1 数据集建设

blocks.en: Controlled description pairs. Each edit pairs source and target descriptions that differ in one semantic attribute while specifying the same remaining scene content. For instance, the color edit in Fig. 6 changes a blue bicycle to a red bicycle, with the bicycle and its surroundings intended to remain unchanged. The benchmark covers 12 12 edit types, each defined by two attribute values ( Tab. 5 ). A context specifies the shared scene details, and initially defines two directed edits , one for each direction of the attribute change.
blocks.zh: 受控描述对. 每个编辑对一个语义属性不同的源和目标描述,同时指定相同的剩余场景内容. 例如,图6中的颜色编辑将一辆蓝色自行车改为一辆红色自行车,自行车及其周围环境打算保持不变。 基准包含12个12个编辑类型,每个类型由两个属性值(Tab. 5 )所定义. 上下文指定了共享的场景细节,并最初定义了两个定向编辑,一个针对属性变化的每个方向.

blocks.en: For each edit type, we divide contexts into disjoint fitting, calibration, and evaluation sets. We use the calibration set to determine FK steering’s editing strength ( Sec. C.2 ). The fitting contexts remain excluded from evaluation. All reported results use the evaluation set.
blocks.zh: 对于每种编辑类型,我们把上下文分为不相通的配位、校正和评价集。 我们使用校正装置来确定FK方向盘的编辑强度(第C.2节)。 适当的环境仍然被排除在评价之外。 所有报告的结果都使用了评价套。

blocks.en: We initially select 16 16 evaluation contexts per edit type and include both directions, yielding 384 384 directed edits. Removing duplicate source–target pairs leaves 356 356 edits. We further exclude overlaps with the fitting and calibration sets, including target-description matches, leaving 316 316 edits across 159 159 contexts: 157 157 with both directions and two with only one. Tab. 5 gives the counts by edit type, and Fig. 6 illustrates the requested changes across all 12 12 types.

blocks.en: Evaluation questions. For each edit, we construct three types of yes/no questions from the dataset record before examining model outputs. These questions are shared across methods and distinguish whether the requested change succeeds from whether other scene details are preserved. We illustrate each question type using the bicycle color edit in Fig. 6 ; the questions below are illustrative. • Subject: Is there a bicycle in the image? The subject is the object or person carrying the edited attribute. For occupational edits, we identify the person by their occupation; for object-category edits, we use a shared category (e.g., “animal”); and for scene-level edits, we use the main object. • Original and target attributes: Is the bicycle blue? Is the bicycle red? These questions assess whether the original attribute is removed and the target attribute is introduced, respectively. • Preservation: Is there a brick wall behind the bicycle? Questions of this type assess scene details unrelated to the requested change. To isolate preservation from edit success, we exclude preservation questions that concern the edited attribute, mention either of its values, or duplicate the subject question. We replace questions requiring direct comparison with a reference image with four single-image questions about lighting, framing, background, and color. Each edit retains 7 7 to 13 13 preservation questions. The same questions are applied independently to the source and edited images, as described in Sec. C.3 .
blocks.zh: 评价问题。 每次编辑时,我们先从数据集记录中构建出三类是/否问题,然后再检查模型输出. 这些问题在方法上是共享的,并区分了所要求的更改是否成功,以及是否保留了其他场景细节. 我们用图6中的自行车颜色编辑来说明每个问题类型;下面的问题就是说明性的。 二. 支助 主体:图像中是否有自行车? 主体为带有被编辑属性的物体或个人. 对于职业编辑,我们按其职业识别人物;对于对象类编辑,我们使用一个共享的分类(如"动物");对于场景级编辑,我们使用主要对象. • 原始和目标属性: 自行车是蓝色的吗? 自行车是红色的吗? 这些问题分别评估原属性是否被去除并引入了目标属性. • 保存: 自行车后面有砖墙吗? 这种类型的问题评估场景细节,与要求的更改无关. 为了将保存与编辑成功区分开来,我们排除了涉及被编辑属性的保存问题,提及其价值或重复主题问题。 我们用四个关于照明、框架、背景和颜色的单一图像问题来取代需要与参考图像直接比较的问题。 每次编辑保留了7个7至13个保存问题. 如第C.3节所描述的,同样的问题独立地应用于源和被编辑的图像。

blocks.en: Subject: Is there a bicycle in the image? The subject is the object or person carrying the edited attribute. For occupational edits, we identify the person by their occupation; for object-category edits, we use a shared category (e.g., “animal”); and for scene-level edits, we use the main object.
blocks.zh: 主体:图像中是否有自行车? 主体为带有被编辑属性的物体或个人. 对于职业编辑,我们按其职业识别人物;对于对象类编辑,我们使用一个共享的分类(如"动物");对于场景级编辑,我们使用主要对象.

blocks.en: Original and target attributes: Is the bicycle blue? Is the bicycle red? These questions assess whether the original attribute is removed and the target attribute is introduced, respectively.
blocks.zh: 原始和目标属性 : 自行车是蓝色的吗? 自行车是红色的吗? 这些问题分别评估了原属性是否被去除并引入了目标属性.

blocks.en: Preservation: Is there a brick wall behind the bicycle? Questions of this type assess scene details unrelated to the requested change.
blocks.zh: 保存 : 自行车后面有砖墙吗? 这类问题评估场景细节,与要求的更改无关。

blocks.en: Counter-stereotypical extension. We also construct a separate cohort of 192 192 edits that move toward or away from stereotypical associations. It covers six association types: occupation–gender (“doctor”), occupation–age (“judge”), activity–gender (“laying bricks”), and three object associations involving pattern, material, or color (a striped deck chair, a wooden broom handle, and a red fire extinguisher). Each record specifies the subject, its stereotypical attribute value, and a physically plausible alternative; these assignments are fixed before examining model outputs. A toward edit introduces the stereotypical value, while an against edit replaces it with the alternative.
blocks.zh: 反定型延伸. 我们还另外建造了192个编辑组,这些编辑组走向或脱离陈规定型的社团。 它包括六个协会类型:职业-性别(“医生”),职业-年龄(“法官”),活动-性别(“铺砖”),以及三个涉及图案、材料或颜色的物体协会(一个有条纹的甲板椅子,一个木制扫帚手柄,以及一个红色灭火器)。 每一份记录都规定了主题、其陈规定型属性价值以及一种实际可行的替代办法;这些任务是在审查示范产出之前确定的。 走向编辑者引入了定型价值,而反对编辑者则取而代之。

blocks.en: Each type contains 30 30 contexts, of which 16 16 are selected for evaluation using the same rule as the main benchmark. Evaluating both directions yields 96 96 toward and 96 96 against edits. Both directions use the same source-validity checks and success criteria.
blocks.zh: 每种类型包含30个上下文,其中16个16个采用与主要基准相同的规则选择进行评价。 评估两个方向的结果是96-96对编辑,96-96对编辑。 两个方向都采用相同的源有效性检查和成功标准.

blocks.en: C.2 Experimental settings
blocks.zh: C.2 实验设置

blocks.en: Source generation and initialization. We generate source images from the source descriptions separately for SD v1.4 and SDXL, using the settings in Sec. B.1 and 100 100 denoising steps. For every edit, the source’s initial noise is generated with random seed 0 0 .
blocks.zh: 来源生成与初始化. 我们利用Sec.B.1和100个去名步骤中的设置,从SD v1.4和SDXL的来源描述中分别生成源图像. 每一次编辑时,源头的初始噪声都是由零零的随机种子所产生.

blocks.en: For each edit, all sampling methods initialize every trajectory with the same initial noise used to generate the source image and denoise under the target description. The trajectories differ in the stochastic noise drawn during subsequent denoising, not in their initial states. We evaluate preservation of the source separately from edit success ( Sec. C.3 ).
blocks.zh: 对于每次编辑,所有采样方法都以相同的初始噪声初始化出每个轨迹,在目标描述下生成出源图像并去出出出出出出出出出. 轨迹在后来去诺音时所画出有花纹的噪声上有所不同,在最初的状态上并非如此. 我们评价保留来源与编辑成功分开(第C.3节)。

blocks.en: Editing reward. We use the Qwen2.5-VL editing reward defined in Sec. B.3 , which favors introducing the target attribute and removing the original attribute.
blocks.zh: 编辑奖励. 我们使用 Sec. B.3 定义的 Quen2.5-VL 编辑奖励,它有利于引入目标属性并去除原始属性.

blocks.en: Sampling configurations. The sampling baselines use the full-trajectory editing configurations in Sec. B.1 .
blocks.zh: 采样配置. 采样基线采用Sec.B.1中的全轨编辑配置.

blocks.en: To account for the editing reward’s different scale, we calibrate FK steering’s strength on 90 90 held-out edits. At the first intermediate checkpoint, both ImageReward and the editing judge score the four particles’ one-step clean-image predictions. For each judge, we compute the difference between the highest and lowest particle rewards, then take the median of these differences across calibration edits. We then multiply FK steering’s ImageReward strength, λ = 10 \lambda=10 , by the ratio of the median ImageReward spread to the median editing-reward spread. This yields λ = 1.21 \lambda=1.21 for editing. None of the calibration edits is included in evaluation.
blocks.zh: 校正FK Direct在90个被搁置编辑的实力。 在第一个中间检查点,Image Reward和编辑判官都得分了四个粒子的单步清洁图像预测. 对于每个法官,我们计算出最高和最低粒子奖励的差别,然后在校正编辑中取出这些差别的中位数. 然后,我们将FK方向盘的图像奖励强度乘以中位数图像奖励传播到中位数编辑奖励传播的比值。 此值为编辑 = 1. 21\ lambda= 1. 21。 校正编辑没有被纳入评价.

blocks.en: TrailMix uses four trajectories, with resampling checkpoints after steps 10 10 , 45 45 , and 80 80 . It generates one eight-step preview per particle at each checkpoint and estimates the steering strength from those preview rewards as described in Sec. B.1 , using target τ = 15 \tau=15 . After denoising, we return the highest-reward image. We use the same configuration for counter-stereotypical edits.
blocks.zh: TrailMix采用四个出行道道,在10-10、45-45和80步后重新设立检查站。 它在每个检查点产生一个8步的每个粒子预览,并使用目标=15\tau=15从Sec.B.1所述预览奖励中估计出方向强度。 发号施令后,我们返回最高回报的形象. 我们使用相同的配置来进行反定型编辑.

blocks.en: Inference cost. We report U-Net evaluations and judge calls as defined in Sec. B.4 . Source-image generation is shared across methods and excluded from editing costs.
blocks.zh: 推论成本. 我们报告U-Net的评价和Sec所界定的法官电话。 B.4. (中文(简体) ). 原始图像的生成由各种方法分担,不计入编辑费用。

blocks.en: C.3 Evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: C.3 评价协议

blocks.en: Source validity and edit success. We evaluate edited images using Gemma 3 27B [ 11 ] , independently of the Qwen judge used during sampling and final selection. An answer counts as “yes” when its probability is at least 0.5 0.5 .
blocks.zh: 源有效性和编辑成功 。 我们用Gemma 3 27B [11] 来评价编辑的图像, 独立于采样和最终选择时使用的Quen法官。 答案在概率至少为0.5 0.5时算作“是”。

blocks.en: We retain only sources that contain the subject and original attribute but not the target attribute. This ensures that the requested edit requires a change. This leaves 240 240 valid sources for SD v1.4 and 283 283 for SDXL.
blocks.zh: 我们只保留包含主体和原始属性的来源,而不保留目标属性. 这保证了请求的编辑需要更改. 这样,SD v1.4的有效来源为240240个,SDXL的有效来源为283 283个。

blocks.en: An edit succeeds if the output retains the subject, removes the original attribute, and introduces the target attribute. EditRate is the percentage of valid sources successfully edited; Context lost is the percentage of valid sources whose edited outputs no longer contain the subject.
blocks.zh: 如果输出保留了主体,删除了原始属性,并引入了目标属性,则编辑成功. EditRate是有效来源成功编辑的百分比;Context lost是已编辑产出不再包含该主题的有效来源的百分比.

blocks.en: Preservation of unchanged attributes. For each preservation question, we compare Gemma’s probability of answering “yes” on the source and edited images and take the absolute difference. We average these differences within each edit, then average across edits with valid sources. This gives every edit equal weight, regardless of how many preservation questions it contains. The resulting preservation error E E ranges from 0 0 to 1 1 ; lower values indicate better preservation. We also report E verified E_{\mathrm{verified}} , calculated in the same way but restricted to successful edits. We report both preservation metrics on their original 0 0 – 1 1 scale throughout.
blocks.zh: 保持不变的属性。 对于每个保存问题, 我们比较Gemma在源头回答“是”的可能性, 我们在每次编辑中平均这些差异,然后在有有效来源的编辑中平均。 这使得每个编辑都具有同等的分量,无论它包含多少保护问题. 由此而来保存出错的E E从0到11;更低的数值表明保存得更好. 我们还报告E 校验的 E_{\mathrm{已校验 } 用同样的方式计算,但仅限于成功的编辑。 我们报告两个保存度量衡 以原来的0比1 整个尺度。

blocks.en: Directional asymmetry. We check source validity separately for the two editing directions. On SD v1.4, 66 66 sources are valid for toward-stereotype edits and 80 80 for against-stereotype edits; the corresponding counts for SDXL are 74 74 and 90 90 . Each directional EditRate uses its own valid-source set. To measure asymmetry on comparable examples, we instead restrict both directions to contexts with valid sources in each direction: 57 57 contexts for SD v1.4 and 69 69 for SDXL. Asymmetry is the absolute difference between the two EditRates computed on this shared set, rather than on separately validated sources. The corresponding signed difference is reported in Sec. D.5 .
blocks.zh: 方向不对称. 我们分别检查两个编辑方向的源有效性. 在SD v1.4上,66个来源对定型编辑有效,80个来源对定型编辑有效;SDXL的相应计数为74 74和90 90。 每个方向编辑器都使用自己的有效源集. 为了衡量可比实例的不对称性,我们把双向限制在每一方向有有效来源的上下文:SD v1.4的上下文57个;SDXL的上下文69个。 非对称性是在本共享集上计算出的两个EditRates的绝对相差,而不是单独验证的源. 相应的签名差额在Sec.D.5.中报告。

blocks.en: Appendix D Analysis and ablations
blocks.zh: 附录D 分析和分析

blocks.en: We first investigate the two mechanisms underlying TrailMix : lookahead-based reward estimation and adaptive steering strength. We then characterize its sensitivity to sampling configurations and assess whether improvements extend to alternative reward judges and evaluators. Finally, we examine how these design choices affect targeted image editing, where edit success must be considered alongside source preservation. Unless stated otherwise, we use SD v1.4 and the task-specific settings in Secs. B.1 , B.2 , B.3 , C.2 and C.3 , varying only the stated configurations. Generation scores follow the main-paper evaluation protocol; Avg. weights the three benchmarks equally, and T2I denotes T2I-CompBench++. Bold indicates the best metric within each comparable block.
blocks.zh: 我们首先调查两起构成TrailMix基础的机制:基于外观的奖励估计和适应性引导力。 然后,我们确定其对抽样组合的敏感性,并评估改进是否扩大到其他奖励法官和评价人员。 最后,我们审查这些设计选择如何影响目标图像编辑,在编辑成功的同时,还必须考虑源头保护。 除非另有说明,我们使用SD v1.4和Secs中特定任务设置. B.1、B.2、B.3、C.2和C.3的配置只有所不同。 生成分数遵循了主纸评价协议;Avg.对三个基准进行等分加权,而T2I表示为T2I-Comp Bench+. 粗体表示每个可比区块内的最佳衡量标准。

blocks.en: D.1 Lookahead-based reward estimation
blocks.zh: D.1 基于视线的奖励估计

blocks.en: Lookahead previews aim to reveal semantic details that are not yet clear in one-step predictions. We investigate whether they improve the identification of promising trajectories, how preview length affects final alignment, and how best to allocate preview computation.
blocks.zh: Lookahead预览旨在揭示一步预言中尚不明确的语义细节. 我们调查它们是否改进了对有希望的轨迹的识别,预览长度如何影响最终对齐,以及如何最好地分配预览计算.

blocks.en: Lookaheads improve early trajectory ranking. To isolate reward estimation from resampling, we generate eight independent trajectories per prompt without resampling, using prompt-index seeds offset by 3,000,000 3{,}000{,}000 . At the steps listed in Tab. 6 , we rank the same trajectories using either a one-step prediction or an eight-step preview. We complete the trajectories and determine their final success using independent benchmark evaluators. These analysis checkpoints do not change the sampling process.
blocks.zh: Lookaheads改进了早期的轨迹排名. 为了将奖励估计从再生中分离出来,我们利用由3 000 000 3{,}000{,} 000相抵消的即时指数种子,在不进行再生的情况下,每快生成8个独立的轨迹。 在Tab中列出的步骤. 6,我们使用一步预告或八步预览来排列相同的轨迹. 我们利用独立的基准评估人员来完成轨迹并确定其最终成功。 这些分析检查站并没有改变取样过程。

blocks.en: We measure the fraction of eventual successes ranked among the top four of eight, restricting the analysis to prompts with both successful and unsuccessful outputs. We pool successful trajectories across these prompts and assign fractional credit to ties at the cutoff. Success means passing the official GenEval checks, obtaining a RareBench rating of at least 4 / 5 4/5 , or satisfying the relevant T2I-CompBench++ criterion (BLIP-VQA binding ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 , UniDet spatial > 0 >0 , or numeracy = 1 =1 ). These binary criteria are used for the trajectory analysis, not the main benchmark scores.
blocks.zh: 我们衡量在八强中排名前四的几分最终成功率,将分析限制在成功和不成功产出两方面。 我们汇集成功的轨迹 跨越这些提示 并在断线时分配分数信用 成功意味着通过正式的GenEval检查,获得至少4 / 5 4/5的Rare Bench评分,或满足相关的T2I-Comp Bench++标准(BLIP-VQA绑定 \ 0.5\ geq) 0.5, UniDet 空间 > 0 > 0,或算术=1=1,这些二进制标准用于轨迹分析,而不是主要基准分数.

blocks.en: Across all three benchmarks, eight-step previews identify more eventual successes than one-step predictions early in denoising, while their rankings become similar near completion ( Tab. 6 ). This demonstrates the value of lookahead evaluation as a selection signal independently of resampling.
blocks.zh: 在所有三个基准中,八步预览比在解密初期的一步预言更能发现最终的成功,而其排名则接近完成(Tab. 6)。 这表明了外观前方评价作为独立于再生的选取信号的价值.

blocks.en: Table 6 : Ranking eventual successes. Percentage of successful trajectories ranked top four of eight, on mixed-outcome prompts. Columns give the denoising step. No resampling; chance level is 50 % 50\% .
blocks.zh: 表6:最终成功排名。 成功轨迹在八分之四中所占百分比,在混合结果提示上排名前四. 列会给出去名阶. 没有复刻; 机会等级为 50% 。

blocks.en: Table 7 : Preview length in generation. Four particles, τ = 1 \tau=1 . T2I denotes T2I-CompBench++; Avg. weights the three benchmarks equally.
blocks.zh: 表7: 预览生成长度. 四颗颗粒,\\ tau=1. T2I表示T2I-Comp Bench+; Avg.对三个基准的权重相等。

blocks.en: Short lookaheads improve alignment without additional judge calls. Varying the preview length, we find that eight-step previews achieve the strongest alignment across all three generation benchmarks. Extending previews to sixteen steps increases denoising cost without improving alignment ( Tab. 7 ).
blocks.zh: 短视者无需增加法官的电话即可改进配对。 不同的预览长度,我们发现八步预览实现所有三代基准最强的对接. 将预览扩展至16个步骤,在不改进对齐性的情况下,会增加取消提名的费用(附件7)。

blocks.en: Longer previews outperform multiple shorter previews at matched denoising cost on GenEval. We compare longer previews with multiple independent continuations per particle. For multiple previews, we average their exponential reward scores before resampling, using only previews from the current checkpoint. At matched denoising cost, a single eight-step preview achieves higher GenEval alignment than the tested combinations of shorter previews and requires fewer judge calls ( Tab. 8 ). Generating four eight-step previews offers only a small further gain at higher cost.
blocks.zh: 更长时间的预览比GenEval上匹配的去诺成本的多个更短的预览要多得多. 我们比较较长的预览和每个粒子的多个独立续作. 对于多个预览,我们平均他们的指数奖励分数后再进行再模拟,只使用当前检查点的预览. 在相匹配的去诺化成本下,一个单一的八步预览比测试后的组合更能实现GenEval对接,并且需要较少的裁判呼叫(Tab. 8.). 创造出四个八步预览,只能以更高的成本提供少量的进一步收益.

blocks.en: Table 8 : Allocation of preview computation. Four particles; m m previews per particle at each checkpoint.
blocks.zh: 表8:预览计算的分配。 四颗颗粒;每个检查点每个颗粒预览米.

blocks.en: D.2 Adaptive steering strength
blocks.zh: D.2 适应性转向力

blocks.en: We examine whether adapting steering strength improves alignment at a fixed preview and resampling budget.
blocks.zh: 我们审查调整指导力量是否改进了固定预览和再抽样预算的调整。

blocks.en: Adaptive steering improves aggregate alignment while retaining more lineages than strong fixed steering. We compare adaptive and fixed strengths at identical preview and resampling budgets. We count surviving ancestors as the number of distinct initial trajectories represented in the final particle population, a measure of lineage retention rather than visual diversity. Adaptive steering matches or exceeds the best tested fixed setting on each benchmark ( Tab. 9 ). Weak fixed steering retains more lineages than adaptive steering but achieves lower aggregate alignment.
blocks.zh: 适应性导线改进了整体对接,同时保留了比坚固的固定导线更多的线条. 我们在相同的预览和再模拟预算中比较适应性和固定性强。 我们把幸存的祖先算作最终颗粒群中代表的显著的初始轨迹数量,这是对分系保留而不是视觉多样性的衡量. 适应性方向盘匹配或超过每个基准上测试最好的固定设置(标签9)。 较弱的固定方向盘保留了比适应性方向盘更多的线条,但实现了更低的总量对齐.

blocks.en: Table 9 : Adaptive versus fixed steering. SD v1.4, four particles, L = 8 L=8 ; all settings use 928 928 U-Net evaluations and 12 12 judge calls. T2I denotes T2I-CompBench++; ancestors count surviving initial lineages.
blocks.zh: 表9:可适应性与固定取向。 SD v1.4, 四颗颗粒, L = 8 L = 8; 所有设置都使用 928 928 U-Net评价以及12个裁判呼叫. T2I表示为T2I-Comp Bench+;祖先数为活生生的起先行.

blocks.en: D.3 Sensitivity to sampling configurations
blocks.zh: D.3 对取样配置的敏感性

blocks.en: We characterize sensitivity to the target mean reward, resampling schedule, and sampling budgets.
blocks.zh: 我们描述对目标敏感意味着奖励、重新取样时间表和抽样预算。

blocks.en: A higher target reward does not necessarily improve alignment. Increasing τ \tau reduces independently evaluated alignment across all three benchmarks with eight-step previews, while shorter previews yield mixed changes ( Tab. 10 ).
blocks.zh: 更高的目标奖励不一定能改善一致性。 增加 \ tau 减少了独立评估的所有三个基准的相通性, 并有八步预览, 而较短的预览则产生混合变化( Tab. 10 )。

blocks.en: Table 10 : Sensitivity to the target mean reward. Four particles; inference costs are identical within each preview length. Bold marks the best score within each block.
blocks.zh: 表10:对目标具有敏感性的奖励。 四颗粒子;推断成本在每个预览长度内相同. 粗体标出每个街区内最好的分数.

blocks.en: Alignment varies modestly across the tested resampling schedules. We vary the number and placement of resampling checkpoints while keeping the other generation settings fixed. At each fixed checkpoint count K K , schedules that begin resampling earlier achieve stronger alignment ( Tab. 11 ). The best three- and four-checkpoint schedules provide only small gains over the default at higher denoising and judge cost, supporting the two-checkpoint configuration as a favorable tradeoff.
blocks.zh: 不同测试的重新取样时间表的校正差异不大。 我们改变重新加印检查站的数量和位置,同时使其他一代人的设置保持不变。 在每一个固定的检查站计数K K中,开始重新取样的时间表可以实现更强大的对齐(Tab. 11.). 最佳的三点和四点检查点时间表只提供比违约小的收益,费用较高,判断费用较高,支持两个检查点配置作为有利的取舍。

blocks.en: D.5 Analysis of targeted image editing

blocks.en: We examine whether the design choices studied in generation have similar effects on editing, and how steering relates to the tradeoff between edit success and source preservation.

blocks.en: Edit success varies modestly across preview configurations. On SEAM-Bench , longer or more numerous previews yield limited gains in EditRate ( Tab. 15 ). This is consistent with the smaller early ranking gain relative to generation when we repeat the no-resampling analysis with eight source-conditioned trajectories per edit, using independent subsequent denoising noise. Qwen2.5-VL scores the previews and Gemma 3 determines success. Among the 104 104 mixed-outcome edits, eight-step previews rank 57.4 % 57.4\% of eventual successes among the top four at step 10 10 , compared with 55.7 % 55.7\% for one-step predictions. On PIE-Bench, longer previews modestly improve edit success with comparable preservation.

blocks.en: Adaptive steering achieves competitive editing success across the tested strengths. blocks.en: Setup. We measure inference time for Single, Best-of-4, FK steering, and TrailMix using SD v1.4 in half precision on one NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU. We use the main 100 100 -step configurations, ImageReward for generation and Qwen2.5-VL-7B for SEAM-Bench editing. Each method is timed on 24 24 GenEval prompts and 24 24 SEAM-Bench edits, after model loading and two untimed warm-up runs. We synchronize the GPU around each query and judge call, batch the particles within each four-particle method, and exclude disk writes. Judge time measures reward scoring; total time also includes denoising, lookaheads, and other sampling operations.
blocks.zh: 设相. 我们用一个NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU上半精度的SD v1.4来测量Single,Best-Of-4,FK方向和TrailMix的推断时间. 我们使用主100-100步配置,图像奖励生成和Qwen2.5-VL-7B用于SEAM-Bench编辑. 每种方法在24个GenEval提示和24个SEAM-Bench编辑上定时,在模型加载和两次未定时取暖后进行. 我们把GPU同步到每个查询和判官呼叫的周围, 将粒子分批到每个四颗粒子方法中, 并排除磁盘写入。 法官时间衡量奖励;总时间还包括点名、取景和其他取样作业。

blocks.en: TrailMix reduces reward-scoring time with similar total latency to FK steering. In both generation and editing, the lower scoring time helps offset the additional computation required by lookahead previews ( Tab. 22 ).
blocks.zh: TrailMix缩短了奖励评分时间,与FK方向盘的总耐用性类似. 在生成和编辑方面,较低的评分时间有助于抵消取景前预览(Tab. 22)所需的额外计算.

blocks.en: Appendix F Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录F 限制

blocks.en: As with other reward-guided methods, TrailMix depends on the quality of its reward judge. We evaluate outputs using independent models and benchmark metrics, but these evaluations cannot fully capture all aspects of image quality or prompt alignment. Lookahead previews also introduce additional computation, with the tradeoff between denoising and judge evaluations depending on the inference setting. Finally, our counter-stereotypical editing experiments assess specific attribute changes and do not establish broader fairness properties of the model or its outputs.
blocks.zh: 与其他奖励指导方法一样,TrailMix取决于其奖励法官的质量. 我们使用独立模型和基准衡量标准来评价产出,但这些评价不能充分反映图像质量的所有方面,也不能迅速调整。 Lookahead预览也引入了额外的计算,根据推论设定,在去名和判断评价之间作出权衡. 最后,我们的反定型编辑实验评估了具体的属性变化,没有确立模型或其输出的更广泛的公平性.

blocks.en: Appendix G Additional Related Work
blocks.zh: 附 录 G 相关工作

blocks.en: The main text focuses on inference-time methods for improving text-image alignment. Here, we discuss related work on image editing and generative debiasing that provides additional context for our editing experiments.
blocks.zh: 主要文字以推论时间方法为主来改进文本图像的对齐. 在这里,我们讨论有关图像编辑和基因解析的相关工作,为我们的编辑实验提供了额外的上下文.

blocks.en: Image editing aims to modify specified attributes while preserving unrelated scene content. Existing approaches use source-image noising [ 29 ] , attention control [ 16 ] , and feature injection or inversion [ 42 , 30 , 20 ] . PIE-Bench evaluates editing methods in terms of both edit success and source preservation [ 20 ] . Related work on generative debiasing seeks to reduce unwanted associations through guidance [ 10 ] , learned embeddings [ 49 ] , or finetuning [ 37 ] , while BendVLM studies training-free interventions on vision-language representations [ 12 ] . Together, these works provide context for our evaluation of whether inference-time particle steering can achieve targeted edits, including counter-stereotypical changes, while preserving unrelated image content.
blocks.zh: 图像编辑旨在修改指定的属性,同时保留无关的场景内容. 现有办法采用源图像点名[29],注意控制[16],特征注入或倒置[42、30、20]。 PIE-Bench从编辑成功和源保存两方面评价编辑方法[20]. 有关基因解析的相关工作力求通过指导[10]、所学嵌入[49]或微调[37]减少不想要的关联,而BendVLM则研究关于视觉语言表述的无培训干预[12]。 这些作品共同为我们评估推论-时间粒子引导能否实现目标编辑,包括反定型变化,同时保留不相干图像内容提供了背景.
